instruction: Work through the pinned Desktop workflow only: Revit 2025, Archicad 27 build 6000 or newer, OpenStudio 3.10.0, and EnergyPlus 25.1.0. The installed entry points are `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`, `C:\Program Files\GRAPHISOFT\Archicad 27\Archicad.exe`, and `C:\openstudio-3.10.0\bin\openstudio.exe`. Starting from init.ifc and workflow_spec.json, run run_revit_stage.ps1, run_archicad_stage.ps1, and run_openstudio_stage.ps1 in exact order. Do not hand-author delivered IFC, OSM, IDF, SQL, JSON, or CSV. Revit must divide the original 152.88 m2 bar-building training suite into geometric LOBBY, CLASSROOM-A, CLASSROOM-B and STORAGE spaces, retain the original training-hall and storage GlobalIds, create a geometric pitched roof, and provide four doors plus three windows with geometric IfcOpeningElement, IfcRelVoidsElement and IfcRelFillsElement relationships. It must export stage1.ifc and revit_handoff.json. Archicad must import stage1.ifc using the supplied IFC4 translator, retain GlobalIds and hosted-opening relationships, validate classroom/storage separation and teaching/support energy properties, and export stage2.ifc, archicad_validation_report.json and archicad_handoff.json keyed by actual IfcSpace GlobalIds. OpenStudio must consume stage2.ifc and that handoff, create four separate thermal zones with handed-off classroom, lobby and storage schedules, loads and outdoor air, forward-translate result.osm to in.idf, and run a real annual EnergyPlus simulation. Save all stage artifacts under `C:\Users\user\Desktop`, including native_stage_log.json, workflow.osw, result.osm, in.idf, flow_report.json, model_summary.csv, energy_report.csv, run\eplusout.sql, and run\eplusout.err. Preserve EW3B09, BAR-BUILDING, GEOMETRIC-FILLINGS and workflow_spec.json tokens. Evaluation parses IFC space geometry, quantities, properties, GlobalIds, roof geometry and every door/window host-opening relation, reconciles Archicad entity counts and handoff values, opens standard EnergyPlus SQLite tables, checks per-zone areas and nonzero simulated energy, and independently reruns EnergyPlus; the evaluator requires the delivered files and model data; hashes, tokens, or JSON without those files do not pass.
